items.raw_excerpt: After years without professional hockey in Hamilton, the wait is almost over. The Hamilton Hammers will play their first regular-season home game Friday night, hosting the Toronto Marlies at TD Coliseum as the new AHL team begins its inaugural season.
items.summary_en: The Hamilton Hammers will play their first regular-season home game on Friday night. They host the Toronto Marlies at TD Coliseum in their first AHL season. Star player Brandon Scanlin said his mom almost cried when he told her he was coming home to play.
items.summary_ko: 해밀턴 해머스가 금요일 밤 첫 정규 리그 홈 경기를 치른다. 새 AHL 팀인 해머스는 TD 콜로세움에서 토론토 말리스와 맞붙는다. 팀의 스타 선수 브랜든 스캔린은 고향으로 돌아와 뛰게 됐다고 어머니께 말했더니 어머니가 거의 울 뻔하셨다고 전했다.
items.title_en: Hamilton Hammers play their first home game Friday
items.title_ko: 해밀턴 해머스, 금요일 첫 홈 경기 나선다
items.title_original: When Hammers star Brandon Scanlin told his mom he's coming home to play AHL hockey 'she almost started crying'

items.raw_excerpt: Limpopo court clears 50 Baphutheng secondary pupils of group copying, ordering release of their withheld matric results
items.summary_en: A court in Limpopo cleared 50 high school students of group copying. It ordered their withheld exam results to be released.

items.raw_excerpt: If you live and work in Spain then this will undoubtedly be one of your favourite words!
items.summary_en: People in Spain often use the word 'puente' for a long weekend. It literally means 'bridge'. The word connects two holidays across a gap.

items.raw_excerpt: We've all tried it: you're in the middle of an important project, and your computer freezes. Today's word of the day is a good one to know to help describe those frustrating situations.
items.summary_en: A Danish media outlet shares its phrase of the day. The expression 'at gå i baglås' describes when a computer freezes. It is a handy way to talk about frustrating moments.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크 매체가 오늘의 덴마크어 표현을 소개했다. 오늘 표현은 컴퓨터가 멈춰 버린 상황을 뜻한다. 답답한 순간을 재미있게 표현하는 말이다.
items.title_en: Danish phrase of the day: to freeze up
items.title_ko: 오늘의 덴마크 표현: 멈춰 버렸을 때 쓰는 말

items.raw_excerpt: This week's headlines included the Finns Party edging into second place in Yle’s party support poll, Migri's plan to publish study materials for Finland’s new citizenship test, and Finns' growing appetite for Karelian pies.
items.summary_en: This week's news from Finland covers a few local topics. The Finns Party moved into second place in a support poll. People in Finland are also eating more Karelian pies.
items.summary_ko: 이번 주 핀란드의 여러 소식이 전해졌다. 정당 지지율 조사에서 핀란드인당이 2위로 올라섰다. 또 핀란드 사람들이 카렐리야 파이를 더 많이 찾는 것으로 나타났다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Karnataka Rajya Raita Sangha and Green Brigade have threatened an indefinite blockade of national highways at all district headquarters across Karnataka from October 13 if the demands of sugarcane growers are not addressed at a high-level meeting convened by Union Minister for Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution Pralhad Joshi in New Delhi on October 12.
items.summary_en: Sugarcane farmers in Karnataka are angry about their problems. Groups say they will block national highways at district offices starting October 13. They want the government to help them at a meeting on October 12.
items.summary_ko: 인도 카르나타카의 사탕수수 농민들이 자신들의 요구가 받아들여지지 않으면 시위에 나서겠다고 밝혔다. 농민 단체들은 10월 13일부터 각 지역 본부의 국도를 무기한 막겠다고 예고했다. 이들은 10월 12일 뉴델리에서 열리는 정부 회의에서 문제가 논의되기를 바라고 있다.
items.title_en: Sugarcane farmers in Karnataka plan highway blockade
items.title_ko: 카르나타카 사탕수수 농민들, 고속도로 봉쇄 예고
items.title_original: Sugarcane farmers threaten highway blockade from October 13

items.summary_en: The Iceland Airwaves 2026 schedule is now live. Eight final artists joined the lineup for the Reykjavik festival. The event brings local and global music fans together in the city.

items.raw_excerpt: El técnico Fernando Ortiz trabajó una formación para el próximo compromiso de los "albos" en la que el arquero caboverdiano dejó el equipo titular y el juvenil regresó al arco.
items.summary_en: Coach Fernando Ortiz set up his team for Colo Colo's next match. Cape Verdean goalkeeper Vozinha will move back to the bench. Young Gabriel Maureira will start in goal again.

items.raw_excerpt: Run Terry Run, a new documentary directed by Sean Menard, offers a deeper look at Terry Fox beyond his status as one of Canada’s most celebrated heroes. The film draws from 96 reels of previously unseen footage from Fox's 1980 Marathon of Hope, and highlights his humour, frustrations and determination to inspire Canadians to support cancer research.
items.summary_en: A new film called Run Terry Run looks at Terry Fox beyond his fame as a Canadian hero. It uses 96 reels of never-before-seen footage from his 1980 Marathon of Hope. The film shows his humour, his hard days, and his drive to help cancer research.
items.summary_ko: 새 다큐멘터리 런 테리 런은 캐나다의 영웅 테리 폭스를 더 가까이서 보여 줍니다. 1980년 희망의 마라톤 당시 공개되지 않았던 필름 96개를 담았습니다. 그의 유머와 힘든 순간, 암 연구를 돕고자 한 의지를 전합니다.
items.title_en: New documentary shows a deeper look at Terry Fox

items.raw_excerpt: RESQ Trust to tranquilise Explorer as tiger re-enters human habitats near Rajamahendravaram, 30 km from the city, amid Operation Stripes.
items.summary_en: A tiger called Explorer has come close to people's homes near Rajamahendravaram, about 30 km from the city. Forest teams restarted Operation Stripes to find and tranquilise it. The goal is to move the tiger back to a safe forest area.

items.raw_excerpt: A first local PISA breakdown shows Reykjavík leading after adjustment and Reykjanesbær below average in all three subjects.
items.summary_en: New PISA results show big gaps between towns in Iceland. Reykjavík came out on top after the numbers were adjusted. The town of Reykjanesbær scored below average in all three subjects.

items.summary_en: Heavy rain flooded a storage site in Parque Patricios. Books and documents at a film museum archive were damaged. People are worried about the lost history.

items.summary_en: Actor Colin Farrell sent a bouquet and a handwritten note to NEST Coventry. The group helps mums of children with special educational needs and disabilities. The kind gift was meant to show love and support.

items.raw_excerpt: Fiscalização será intensificada principalmente em SP e no Pará por causa das peregrinações à Basílica de Aparecida e ao Círio de Nazaré.
items.summary_en: Brazil's highway police start a special traffic safety operation on Friday. Patrols will increase in Sao Paulo and Para during pilgrimages to Aparecida and the Círio de Nazaré. The goal is to keep travelers safe on busy roads.
